decisions.statement: The line has the workstation's load, the fleet's spend, and a section for each stoplight group.
A group's stoplights are the readout pages naming that group.
A readout's reading is read off the file beside that readout's page.
The rungs a reading is read against are read off the scale the readout names.
A readout its own page stills is left out.
One reading of the readout pages answers the workstation's load and every stoplight group.
A group answering no stoplight is answered as nothing rather than as an empty row.
The folders a watch of this line follows are the folders the readout and account pages sit in.
Nothing here reaches the pages service.
Nothing here starts a child process.
Nothing here runs on a beat.
Nothing here says which glyph a tier draws.
The workstation's load is each workstation readout's last reading, found by wire key.

definition: the one line the editor's status bar is drawn from
